title: Holds exactly 3 cups.
text: Holds exactly 3 cups.. It’s cheap plastic. I wasn’t expecting glass quality or anything. Not sure why but mentally I was expecting bigger size. It holds exactly 3 cups. It’s the size of my hand (pic added for size reference). Honestly it’s probably only going to hold snacks or something. This (to me) is more of a kid size portion. I prefer to eat fewer/larger meals (bs smaller meals throughout the day) and my intention was to have it hold a big ol salad for lunch. My own fault for not mentally converting the oz listed into cups. It’s quality is flimsy plastic. Could prob get a couple uses if you hand wash; but nothing long term.
